steps.executor_prompt: Interaction safety: Never press Android Back while Chrome is foregrounded. Do not use Android Recents or browser history. Never reuse a UI index after the screen changes. After every launch, dismissal, navigation, field entry, or submission, end the action batch and re-observe before using another index. Open Default Browser and go to groupme.com in Chrome, dismiss setup prompts one at a time, navigate directly to the requested target, and verify the exact target domain. Wait and re-observe if the page is blank or loading. Use only the target's native sign-in form; if an unrelated identity provider opens, enter the target URL directly in the current omnibox, submit, and re-observe. Enter {user} directly into its currently observed field, then re-observe. If the observation exposes the intended value, advance. If the accessibility output omits the field value without showing it empty and the target shows no missing-field error, treat that omission as inconclusive and use the newly observed target submit control once; re-observe the target's validation before any retry. Enter {password} only in its newly observed matching field when requested, then re-observe and submit once with the newly observed control. Do not hide the keyboard with Android Back. If a saved-password or touch-to-fill sheet blocks the form, dismiss it with its visible control or swipe it downward, then re-observe; if it clearly matches {user} and the exact target and cannot be dismissed, use its visible sign-in control and re-observe. Recover an entry only when the target reports that field missing or empty: refocus the newly observed field, enter it once, use a visible keyboard Next or Done control if available, and re-observe before submitting. If the target still reports it missing or empty, report failure. Stop successfully only when the exact target confirms a new OTP was sent or shows a target-owned OTP input field.
steps.auditor_prompt: AUDIT ONLY. Do not tap, type, swipe, or change anything on screen. Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: Pass when the exact target in {name} visibly confirms that a new OTP was requested or sent, or shows a target-owned OTP input form. Judge the full current screen, not only enumerated clickable elements; a browser overlay does not invalidate success when the target-owned OTP form remains visibly identifiable behind it. An ordinary credential form, a matching destination URL alone, browser chrome without identifiable target-owned OTP content, a new-tab page, an unrelated page, or a prompt that fully obscures the target state is incomplete and must not pass.. Do not rely on memory or on what an earlier agent claimed -- judge only from what is visible right now. If you cannot clearly confirm success, treat it as not passed. Report your verdict as structured output.
